newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGIP says in talks with De Benedetti.
newsitem.headline: CGIP says in talks with De Benedetti.

text.p: French company CGIP chairman Ernest-Antoine Seilliere is in talks with Italian industrialist Carlo De Benedetti and the two are discussing their options, a CGIP spokeswoman said.
"We don't deny that we have contacts and discussions," the spokeswoman said.

CGIP earlier denied newspaper reports that it was set to launch a public offer for De Benedetti's holding company Cerus or car parts maker Valeo, in which Cerus holds a 28 percent stake. The spokeswoman declined to elaborate on the options. "I can't say what may happen," she said.
The company's denial took the steam out of an early rally in shares in Cerus and Valeo, but share analysts were speculating that some other form of merger may be on the cards.
"There isn't this much smoke without fire," one analyst said. "The newspaper details were too precise."
French authorities and carmakers are pushing for a French buyout of Valeo, the leading equipment supplier to Renault SA and PSA Peugeot Citroen.
